payload.rationale: This sprint retro directly echoes the existing Sprint 4 Retro content: the async decision widget (Position_Sprint4ThesisProven, Position_CoreFeatureDecisionCapture), the 23-point velocity claim (Obs_TinaVelocity, StyleObs_Sprint4_MetricAnchor — exact quote match), and the Zephyr integration as key unlock (Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock, Obs_ZephyrRateLimitResolved, Position_WebhookArchitecture). I expanded the two core narratives (Narrative_DecisionCaptureAtConsensus, Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning) and the foundational problem narrative (Narrative_DecisionsEvaporate) because the widget embodies these theses and the passes need them to place or extend. I also included the positioning, pricing, product-category, target-market, and next-sprint positions because a retro document can bear on or update any of these frames. No area was deliberately excluded — the graph is small and every position plausibly overlaps this document's themes.
